sources.quote: SC-BR225-YS,BR-225,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250

findings.why: The drawing in force (rev B) requires EN AW-6082-T6 for BR-225. EN AW-7075 is a different alloy and is not the drawing grade. Its capability against the yield special characteristic (at least 250 MPa) is not documented either.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts

findings.why: BR-225 belongs to PRG-X (Aurelia). Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual, which replaces revision 3, lists a change of material as needing written Aurelia approval before shipment. It also requires 90 days' notice. No approval is on file.
EN AW-7075 is not in the material master. There is no yield or other data to judge it against the 250 MPa requirement. Owner: quality engineer for aluminium parts (M. Rossi) / process engineer.

No EN 10204 3.1 certificate for EN AW-7075 exists for any supplier. The only BR-225 source on file (SUP-B) has certificates for 6082-T6 and 6061-T6 only. The supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo) needs to answer this.
